title: Always Show Mit Bestand Aggregator Tour After Refresh
description: The Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator should always show its introduction tour after the window is refreshed. Currently the first-run-seen flag is persisted in localStorage so the tour only auto-starts once per device. Make the Aggregator brand always replay the tour on every load/refresh (clean long-term brand-level policy, not a one-off hack).
summary: Aggregator brand now replays its introduction on every window load. Added ShellBrand.replayIntroductionOnLoad; enabled it on entwerfen-mit-bestand; shell skips reading/writing the device-local seen flag for that policy. Unit tests and a Playwright refresh check confirmed the tour still appears when ui.introduction.seen.* is already set.
